# Virendra Research Chem LLP

Virendra Research Chem LLP is a chemical manufacturer based in Navi Mumbai, Maharashtra, India.

The company focuses on:
- Aroma chemicals
- Pheromone intermediates
- Specialty chemical intermediates
- Custom synthesis and scale-up support
